worldcombat.skill.clearsmog.summary: Throws a clod that bursts into enemy-only clearing smoke. It wipes positive stat changes and removable buffs, repeatedly clearing new boosts while attached, and leaves lowered stats alone. Free aim at a point or direction; walls stop the clod.
worldcombat.skill.clearsmog.use.0: Wipe a target's stacked stat changes back to neutral
worldcombat.skill.clearsmog.use.1: Stop a target that just maxed its boosts from holding them
worldcombat.skill.clearsmog.use.2: Clear the stat changes of a small clustered group at once
The clod deals about %1$s special damage on hit and reaches %2$s blocks; it can be thrown freely at a point or direction, and only a live non-allied entity pulls it slightly onto course.
The %1$s-block smoke cloud wipes enemies’ positive stat changes and removable potion/beacon buffs (lowered stats stay). It clings for %2$s and clears newly gained boosts again every %3$s.
The clump flies at %1$s blocks/tick and lightly steers to the target, with a %2$s block cross-section.
worldcombat.skill.clearsmog.billow.on: Billow: cloud radius x1.5 and cling x1.4, but power x0.85, wind-up +1 tick, cooldown +8 ticks - covers wider and longer.
worldcombat.skill.clearsmog.billow.off: Packed: power x1.15, faster throw and shorter cooldown, but a smaller cloud and a shorter cling - one precise heavy clump.
Wind-up %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s; the PP 15 price.
worldcombat.skill.clearsmog.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.clearsmog.growth.0: From level %1$s the clump power rises to %2$s and the cloud radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.clearsmog.growth.1: From level %1$s the clump power rises to %2$s, the cling to %3$s s and the throw distance to %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.clearsmog.preference.b: On (billow): cloud radius x1.5 and cling x1.4, but power x0.85, wind-up +1 tick, cooldown +8 ticks. Off (packed, default): power x1.15, faster throw and shorter cooldown, but a smaller cloud and a shorter cling.
worldcombat.skill.clearsmog.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
Clear smog is only ranked above ordinary fighting once the target's total positive stages reach this; 1 prefers wiping at the first sign of a boost, higher waits until the target has stacked up.
